description: This file defines the MidiPortWrapper class, which encapsulates a MIDI device and port description, providing methods for accessing port information, generating string representations, and equality checks.

classes.name: MidiPortWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for representing a MIDI device port, including its identification, properties, and string representation.

methods.name: MidiPortWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with device info, port type, and port index.

methods.name: updateString
methods.description: Generates a string description of the MIDI port, including device ID, name, port index, and port name.

methods.name: findPortInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the PortInfo object matching the stored port index and type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the MIDI port wrapper.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another MidiPortWrapper object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on port index, type, and device info.
